answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the lotus of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
